I’d fix these before merging `excerpt-helper` (`59856d7`) into `main`:

1. **[P1] Short text is truncated and always gets an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`  
   There’s no early return when the text fits. `excerpt('hello world', 20)` returns `"hello…"`, losing `"world"`; `excerpt('', 20)` returns `"…"`. This violates the documented unchanged-text and ellipsis-only-on-removal behavior.

2. **[P2] A word ending exactly at the limit is unnecessarily dropped** — `src/words.js:2–4`  
   The search excludes the character at `limit`, even when it’s the separating space. `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` rather than `"one two…"`. Check whether the limit already falls at a word boundary before backing up. The current words test actually enshrines this bug.

3. **[P2] Markdown stripping deletes literal content** — `src/plain.js:3`  
   Removing every underscore, tilde, and backtick treats literal characters as formatting. For example, `toPlain('use snake_case')` returns `"use snakecase"`. Strip recognized Markdown constructs rather than those characters globally, and cover literal punctuation/code in tests.

**Validation:** All four existing tests pass; the examples above reproduce the gaps. Also, `src/card.js` still only trims the body—it doesn’t call either new helper, so this branch doesn’t yet change card previews end to end.

No files changed.
